name: Mugiwara Store Shibuya
name_ja: 麦わらストア 渋谷本店
note: The main One Piece store, on MAGNET by SHIBUYA109 6F right at the Scramble Crossing. Usually 10:00–21:00.

name: Mugiwara Store Ikebukuro
name_ja: 麦わらストア 池袋
note: Sunshine City Alpa 2F. Usually 10:00–20:00.

name: Mugiwara Store Odaiba
name_ja: 麦わらストア お台場
note: DiverCity Tokyo Plaza 2F, next to the life-size Gundam.

name: Mugiwara Store Tokyo Station
name_ja: 麦わらストア 東京駅
note: Tokyo Character Street (B1, Ichibangai) under Tokyo Station. Usually 10:00–20:30.

name: Mugiwara Store Harajuku
name_ja: 麦わらストア 原宿
note: Harakado, ground floor. Usually 11:00–21:00.

name: Mugiwara Store Umeda
name_ja: 麦わらストア 梅田
note: LUCUA SOUTH 13F, Osaka Station. LUCUA SOUTH reopens on 24 Nov 2026; for a while after that, floors 10–13 may need a lottery or numbered ticket.

name: Mugiwara Store Abeno
name_ja: 麦わらストア あべの
note: Abeno Q's Mall 3F, Tennoji. Usually 10:00–21:00.

name: Mugiwara Store Mini Kyoto
name_ja: 麦わらストア MINI 京都
note: A small One Piece corner inside Kiddyland Kyoto, Shijo-Kawaramachi. Usually 11:00–21:00.

name: Mugiwara Store Kumamoto
name_ja: 麦わらストア 熊本
note: AMU Plaza Kumamoto 6F, at Kumamoto Station. Usually 10:00–20:00.

name: Luffy statue
name_ja: ルフィ像
note: The first Straw Hat statue (2018), on the promenade of the Kumamoto Prefectural Government Office. Bus stop: Kumamoto Kencho-mae, where the airport bus also stops.

name: Chopper statue
name_ja: チョッパー像
note: Outside the main gate of Kumamoto Zoo and Botanical Gardens. Tram to Doshokubutsuen-iriguchi, then about 10 minutes on foot. The zoo is closed on Mondays.

name: Zoro statue
name_ja: ゾロ像
note: Ozu Central Park, a 6–8 minute walk from JR Higo-Ozu station on the Hohi line. The Airport Liner bus from Higo-Ozu reaches the airport in 15 minutes.

name: Usopp statue
name_ja: ウソップ像
note: In front of JR Aso Station on the Hohi line. The most visited statue.

name: Franky statue
name_ja: フランキー像
note: In front of Takamori Station. JR to Tateno, then the Minamiaso Railway.

name: Brook statue
name_ja: ブルック像
note: Beside the Mifune Dinosaur Museum. Kumamoto Bus from Sakuramachi Bus Terminal, about 45 minutes.

name: Sanji statue
name_ja: サンジ像
note: MINATERAS in Mashiki. Easiest by car or taxi.

name: Nami statue
name_ja: ナミ像
note: Tawarayama Koryukan Moenosato, Nishihara. About 11 minutes by the Takamori-go bus from the airport, otherwise by car.

name: Robin statue
name_ja: ロビン像
note: Former Tokai University Aso Campus. Open 9:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30), closed on Mondays. Needs a car or taxi.

name: Jinbe statue
name_ja: ジンベエ像
note: The largest statue, in Sumiyoshi Seaside Park, Uto. About 35 minutes by car, or JR to Uto and about 15 minutes by bus to Sumiyoshi Kaigan.

name: Shibuya Scramble Crossing (Shibuya Incident)
name_ja: 渋谷スクランブル交差点
note: Where the curtain goes up at the start of the Shibuya Incident.

name: Shibuya Station Fukutoshin Line platform
name_ja: 渋谷駅 副都心線ホーム
note: B5F platform where Gojo is sealed in the Prison Realm. It is behind the ticket gates, so you need a ticket.

name: Shibuya Mark City
name_ja: 渋谷マークシティ
note: The Restaurant Avenue entrance, where Naobito is stationed during the Shibuya Incident.

name: Shibuya Hikarie
name_ja: 渋谷ヒカリエ
note: ShinQs B1F appears in manga chapter 83.

name: Meiji-jingumae Station
name_ja: 明治神宮前駅
note: Where Mei Mei's team arrives and Yuji splits off in the Shibuya Incident.

name: Shinjuku no Me
name_ja: 新宿の目
note: The 'Shinjuku Eye' art piece in the west-exit underground passage. Todo poses in front of it in the anime opening.

name: Jujutsu Kaisen Finale Exhibition
name_ja: 呪術廻戦 展
note: Only 25 Dec 2026 – 25 Jan 2027, at Shinjuku Sumitomo Building Triangle Square. Timed tickets through e+; general sale from 21 Nov.

name: Sendai Station (Kikufuku)
name_ja: 仙台駅
note: Yuji's home city. Gojo buys Kikusui-an's Kikufuku sweets at the station.

name: Jujutsu Kaisen manholes (Izumi-Chuo)
name_ja: 泉中央駅
note: Three Jujutsu Kaisen manhole covers at Izumi-Chuo Station, with one more in Nanakita Park.

name: Sakurajima (Culling Game colony)
name_ja: 桜島
note: A real Culling Game colony. 15-minute ferry from Kagoshima; no sailings between midnight and about 4am.

name: Kyoto Tower
name_ja: 京都タワー
note: Appears in a manga flashback (chapter 17). Right across from Kyoto Station.

name: Jump Shop Shibuya
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 渋谷
note: Shibuya PARCO 6F. Official Shonen Jump store: One Piece and Jujutsu Kaisen goods.

name: Jump Shop Tokyo Station
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 東京駅
note: Tokyo Character Street B1.

name: Jump Shop Ikebukuro
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 池袋
note: Ikebukuro PARCO B2F.

name: Jump Shop Tokyo Skytree Town
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 東京スカイツリータウン
note: Tokyo Solamachi 4F, at the foot of the Skytree.

name: Jump Shop Tokyo Dome City
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 東京ドームシティ

name: Jump Shop Umeda
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 梅田
note: HEP FIVE 6F, the building with the red Ferris wheel.

name: Jump Shop Shinsaibashi
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 心斎橋
note: Daimaru Shinsaibashi main building 9F, walking distance from Dotonbori.

name: Jump Shop Tennoji
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 天王寺
note: Tennoji MIO 6F.

name: Jump Shop Hiroshima
name_ja: ジャンプショップ 広島
note: MINAMOA 5F, in the Hiroshima Station building. Easy to visit while changing trains.

name: Mugiwara Store Nagoya
name_ja: 麦わらストア 名古屋
note: In Nagoya PARCO, Sakae. The only one in the Tokai region. Check the floor and hours on mugiwara-store.com before you go.
